biggest_catch: Membership limited to six Florida counties (Brevard, Indian River, Orange, Osceola, Polk, Volusia); $500+ direct deposit must be maintained for three consecutive months and bonus posts only after a further 90 days.
catches: Membership limited to six Florida counties: Brevard, Indian River, Orange, Osceola, Polk, Volusia; not nationwide.
A share savings account with a $5 one-time membership fee is required at account opening.
$5 one-time membership fee required at account opening.
Not available to current CCU Florida checking holders, joint owners on a checking account, or anyone who closed a checking account within the past 24 months.
Offer window is short: must open July 1 - September 25, 2026 (ends in ~2 days).
$500+ direct deposit must post within 90 days of opening AND continue for three consecutive months.
Only paycheck, pension, or government benefits count as qualifying direct deposit; transfers and person-to-person transfers do not qualify.
Bonus posts by the 5th of the month following the 90-day period after requirements are met — a long payout wait (~4-6 months total).
Free Checking Plus earns its 2.50% APY only with 20 debit-card uses per month plus eStatements; APY tiers as of 2/1/2026 are subject to change.
Account must remain open; terms silent on early closure clawback but payout requires waiting out the full qualification period.

eligibility: US person eligible for CCU Florida membership: residents in Brevard, Indian River, Orange, Osceola, Polk & Volusia Counties (Florida). 18+ (or minor with guardian per standard CU rules). Not a current CCU Florida checking holder, not a joint owner on a checking account, and no checking closed in the past 24 months. New account subject to approval (ChexSystems/identity verification typical).

s1.note: Bonus payout is slow: posts by the 5th of the month following the 90-day period after all requirements are met (~4-6 months total).

s2.note: Geo-restricted to six Florida counties; membership requires a $5 one-time share savings fee.

s3.note: Deposit is not the primary requirement; the qualifier is $500+/month in paycheck/pension/government-benefit direct deposits for three consecutive months.

s4.note: No recurring fees: Free Checking Plus has zero monthly fees or balance requirements; no forced add-ons.

s6.note: Terms page does not state bonus tax reporting; US bank bonuses are generally taxable income — consult the credit union's tax documents.

steps: Open a Free Checking Plus account (online via the app.consumer.meridianlink.com link or in person), mention or enter promo code MK-CHECKING during the application, and pay the $5 one-time share savings membership fee at account opening.
Establish a qualifying direct deposit of $500 or more within 90 days of account opening; acceptable deposits are a paycheck, pension, or government benefits such as Social Security.
Continue receiving direct deposit of $500 or more for three consecutive months.
Keep the account open; the $250 bonus posts by the 5th of the month following the 90-day period after meeting the requirements.
timing: Bonus posts by the 5th of the month following the 90-day period after all requirements are met. Direct deposit must be established within 90 days of opening and continue for three consecutive months. Offer must be opened between July 1 and September 25, 2026.
